input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo developing, deploying, marketing, selling and supporting revenue-generating software products; merge when done.
task: Deepen (flagship 9) league-schedule-generator: the parked availability follow-ups (team rosters, organiser CSV of answers, SMTP reminder to short teams)
errors: venture-preflight caught availabilityCsv defusing plain negative numbers (check_csv_formula_guard); fixed in the PR

doc_friction.issue: `import { chromium } from "playwright"` from an ESM script outside a project fails (global CommonJS module at /opt/node-tools); needed `import pw from require.resolve path; const { chromium } = pw`.

deviations.why: Start here picked chant-forge; 14 sessions in 2 days left it judging its OMR/coda items marginal, and that still held. Took league-schedule-generator, whose parked availability follow-ups are user-facing features that compete with paid RSVP tools, closer to the owner's revenue brief than more bowling SAT tables.
deviations.did: built rosters, answers CSV and SMTP reminders
deviations.result: landed with 10 new tests and a Chromium check

notes: availability-roster.test.mjs 10/10 and availability.test.mjs 9/9 pass locally; deploy.test.mjs passes (Dockerfile copies mailer.mjs). Chromium: the name box's datalist follows the picked team's roster, teams without one take free text, answer saved, no page errors. Not checked: TLS/STARTTLS against a real SMTP provider, real inbox delivery. run_venture_tests.py league-schedule-generator: ok (626 tests, 276.8 s). venture-preflight: first run failed check_csv_formula_guard (plain negative numbers were defused), fixed; second run 'preflight clean'. PR check runs: none triggered (0 check runs), so merged on local verification.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: rosters, CSV export, SMTP client with tests and docs: about a day and a half for a senior Node developer

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
